panoramica.options.resolution.vanilla_25: Vanilla-style menu panorama size. Small files, quick capture, and best for background use.
panoramica.options.resolution.balanced_5: A balanced preset with sharper detail while staying light on disk and GPU memory.
High quality. Similar to Minecraft's debug panorama output size, with noticeably larger files.
panoramica.options.resolution.very_high_: Very high quality for large displays. Capture may pause the game briefly on slower hardware.
panoramica.options.resolution.ultra_2048: Maximum preset. Best for archival screenshots, but the heaviest option for GPU memory and disk space.
panoramica.options.menu_mode.desc: Chooses which panorama is used behind menu screens. If no saved panorama is found, Minecraft's vanilla panorama is shown.
panoramica.options.cycle_interval.desc: How long each saved panorama stays visible when cycling between all panoramas.
panoramica.options.cycle_interval.inacti: Only used when Menu Background is set to Cycle Between All Panoramas.
panoramica.options.storage.desc: Chooses the parent folder for new panorama screenshots. Each capture is still saved in its own timestamped subfolder.
panoramica.capture.started: Taking a panorama screenshot. Each image will be %s pixels...
panoramica.capture.in_progress: A panorama screenshot is already being captured.
panoramica.capture.unavailable: Panorama screenshots can only be taken while in a world.
panoramica.capture.partial_failure: Panorama screenshot finished, but at least one face could not be saved. Folder: %s
